description: This file defines the 'EmailsController' class for SuiteCRM, managing email-related actions such as composing, sending, replying, forwarding, importing emails, handling draft emails, and interacting with email folders and attachments. It includes methods for rendering views, processing email requests, and enforcing permissions.

classes.name: EmailsController
classes.description: Controller class handling email operations, including composing, sending, replying, forwarding, importing, attachment handling, folder management, and permission checks within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: action_index
methods.description: Sets the view to list display of emails.

methods.name: action_DetailDraftView
methods.description: Sets the view to display email draft details.

methods.name: action_ComposeView
methods.description: Prepares the email compose view, optionally for popup UI, including recipient setup.

methods.name: action_QuickCreate
methods.description: Creates a new email record via quick create modal, associates it with related records.

methods.name: action_send
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an email, including validation, attachment processing, and status updates.

methods.name: replaceEmailVariables
methods.description: Parses and replaces variables in email templates based on the associated bean data.

methods.name: isValidRequestForReplaceEmailVariables
methods.description: Validates if the request is suitable for email variable replacement, logging issues.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at specified levels.

methods.name: action_SaveDraft
methods.description: Saves the current email as a draft.

methods.name: action_DeleteDraft
methods.description: Deletes a draft email.

methods.name: action_Popup
methods.description: Displays the email-related popup view.

methods.name: action_getFromFields
methods.description: Retrieves possible 'from' email addresses with signatures for the current user.

methods.name: action_GetDraftAttachmentData
methods.description: Returns attachment info for a draft email.

methods.name: action_CheckEmail
methods.description: Checks inbound emails for new messages.

methods.name: action_GetFolders
methods.description: Retrieves email folder structure asynchronously.

methods.name: action_DisplayDetailView
methods.description: Displays email details based on UID and inbound email record, with validation.

methods.name: action_ImportAndShowDetailView
methods.description: Imports email from inbound server and displays the detail view.

methods.name: action_ImportView
methods.description: Displays email import view.

methods.name: action_GetCurrentUserID
methods.description: Outputs the current user's ID in JSON.

methods.name: action_ImportFromListView
methods.description: Imports emails from a folder, with options to import all or specific UIDs.

methods.name: action_ReplyTo
methods.description: Prepares email reply composition.

methods.name: action_ReplyToAll
methods.description: Prepares email reply-all composition.

methods.name: action_Forward
methods.description: Prepares email forward composition.

methods.name: action_ComposeViewWithPdfTemplate
methods.description: Fills compose view with PDF template content.

methods.name: action_SendDraft
methods.description: Sends a draft email via AJAX.

methods.name: action_MarkEmails
methods.description: Marks emails on the mail server with specified flags.

methods.name: action_DeleteFromImap
methods.description: Deletes email from IMAP server, with support for multiple UIDs.

methods.name: markEmails
methods.description: Handles marking emails with flags on the server based on request parameters.

methods.name: composeBean
methods.description: Populates the email compose bean with data based on the mode (reply, forward, etc.), including setting subjects and bodies appropriately.

methods.name: setAfterImport
methods.description: Sets fields on imported email record, excluding certain fields.

methods.name: userIsAllowedToSendEmail
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to send an email from the specified inbound and outbound accounts.
